laws.rule: Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park, Accra: photography is allowed only in permitted areas. Respect relics and facilities, use the bins, remain silent in designated areas, and follow staff instructions. Events must be booked and approved in advance. Its FAQ publishes daily 08:30 to 23:00 hours, expressly subject to change without notice. This is the park operator's site rule, not a region-wide photography restriction.

Parliament House, Accra: group and educational visits require a written request to the Director of Public Engagement or the published online application. When observing debates, photography needs permission; packages, binoculars, photographic/recording equipment and other electronic devices must be checked in at entry. Switch phones off and follow security and Speaker instructions. Do not clap, demonstrate or give loud commentary in the gallery.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Parliament House public gallery, Accra: Parliament requires formal dress befitting the House. Visitors must stand each time the Speaker's procession enters or leaves the chamber. Observe without loud commentary, clapping or demonstrations and follow the Speaker and security staff. These are institution-specific visitor protocols, not a dress rule throughout Greater Accra.
